phrases: A book to transform difficult conversations into mutual agreements.

paragraphs: It's not about winning at all costs. It's about building bridges, understanding the other, and finding common ground. Negotiating beautifully is, in essence, an act of empathy and strategy.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.description: Communicate your intention with simplicity and honesty. Transparency is the shortest path to trust.

activeListening.title: Active Listening
activeListening.description: Listen to understand, not just to respond. Understand the needs and motivations of the other party.

mutualRespect.title: Mutual Respect
mutualRespect.description: Hold your position without breaking the relationship. Respect is the foundation of any lasting and beneficial agreement.

extracts: Clarity is not a starting point, it is a result. It is built.
Listen to understand, not to respond. That is the key.
Negotiating beautifully is about caring for the relationship without betraying your intention.
